name: employment-compliance
description: Employment law and compliance for B2B SaaS founders — contractor vs employee classification, offer letters, IP assignment (PIIA), at-will employment, equity documentation, employee handbooks, harassment policies, termination procedures, and multi-state / international hiring compliance. Use when hiring first employees, classifying workers, building HR infrastructure, or expanding to new states/countries. Triggers on: "employment law", "contractor vs employee", "offer letter", "employee handbook", "PIIA", "hiring compliance", "termination".
